source.directorySummary: Implements the file `history` subcommand that shows recent git commits for a workspace-relative path, handling path resolution, git log execution, and CLI/web result rendering.

adapter.ts.sourceSummary: Adapts parsed history command params to `handleHistoryCommand` (maxCount 20) and renders the result as CLI text or web node via `renderFileHistoryWeb`.

definition.ts.sourceSummary: Defines the `history` subcommand with optional workspace-relative `path` argument and example invocations.

handler.ts.sourceSummary: Resolves and validates the workspace path, verifies git repository, runs `git log` with relative dates and parses `git show --numstat` stats into `FileHistoryResult`.

summary.value: plugins/file/commands/history implements the `file history` subcommand that displays recent git commits for a workspace-relative path via path resolution and git log execution with CLI/web rendering. Its child `renderers` provides the web presentation, converting FileHistoryResult into a styled tree with file breadcrumb, clickable commit subjects that dispatch diff actions, and per-commit file/addition/deletion metrics.

context.value: plugins/file — workspace file-manager plugin in AppWeaver system: tree browsing, view/edit/create/delete/rename/restore, git diff/history/commit/restore/init, NIP-44/Blossom encrypted upload/download, and bottom-up docs via centralized dispatcher + plugin registration + AI tooling + fuzzy-file-search; ai complete (Zod-validated bottomup.generate/enrich/summarize/summary contracts, runtime dispatch via workspace root, in-memory DB); commands complete container (20 CLI/web subcommands: bottomup workflows with coverage validation/effective context/hash-cache/recursive/one-level/plan-draft-accept and index validation/projections, filesystem ops with size/binary/IGNORE/.gitignore filtering via ripgrep, git ops, secure transfer with naddr/NIP-44/integrity handling, shared workspace-root validation/filter/renderer/help under containment); types complete (adapter param contracts); no missing/stale coverage.

enrichment.directorySummary: Read-only git-introspection member of the file plugin's git-operations family (alongside diff/commit/restore/init) under the commands aggregation boundary. Provides the audit-trail surface dispatched from the centralized adapter.ts/handleFile dispatcher, complementing diff's single-commit inspection and commit/restore's mutating operations with a non-mutating, path-scoped log view. Follows the shared validate-containment → verify-repo → execute-git pattern but does not participate in bottomup hash-cache/coverage lifecycle; isolates execution in handler.ts and delegates all styled presentation and diff-action dispatch to the renderers child.

files.adapter.ts: Dispatch and presentation fork for this subcommand — invoked from the central file dispatcher, hardcodes maxCount 20 for handleHistoryCommand, and branches results into CLI text vs web tree via renderFileHistoryWeb; sole bridge between parsed params, handler execution, and renderers output.
files.definition.ts: Declarative contract for the history subcommand registered via the file plugin init flow; exposes the optional workspace-relative path argument and example invocations that drive help generation and param validation for the adapter/handler chain.
files.handler.ts: Execution core for the subcommand implementing the shared workspace-resolution → git-repo verification → git log (relative dates) + git show --numstat parsing pipeline; produces the typed FileHistoryResult with per-commit file/addition/deletion metrics consumed by adapter and web renderers.
